sources.entry: Airpass - Status bar Mac application to overcome time constrained WiFi networks.

summary.one_liner: Airpass is a macOS status bar app that renews your MAC address with one click to get more time on time-limited WiFi networks.
summary.what_it_does: Airpass sits in the Mac status bar and, when clicked, renews the machine's MAC address. The README describes this as a way to trick WiFi networks that cap access at a fixed period, such as 30 minutes. The README gives no further detail on features, settings, or how the renewal is performed. It can be built from source using npm, with a start command for running it. The Downloads section is present but has no listed binaries in the README text provided.
use_cases: bypass 30-minute hotel or cafe WiFi limits
run a menubar utility from source with npm
notable: One-click MAC address renewal from the macOS status bar
Targets WiFi networks with time-limited access
Can be built from source with npm
caveats: README is brief and gives no detail on compatibility, macOS versions, or how the MAC renewal works
The Downloads section for OSX has no listed artifacts in the README text
Circumventing network time limits may conflict with a network's terms of use
